sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: getting-started/installation
sources.finding: Windows x64, macOS Intel/ARM and Linux x86_64 downloads; local provider runtime required.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: getting-started/providers
sources.finding: Synara controls installed runtimes; account/model permissions remain provider-owned. Stable and development availability may differ.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: getting-started/first-task
sources.finding: Local folder, provider/model and Local or Worktree environment are selected before work.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/provider-accounts
sources.finding: Multiple account configurations and provider-native sign-in are supported, with account-specific models and usage snapshots.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/hubs
sources.finding: Stable Hubs coordinate workers with shared memory and a Git-versioned Library; concurrency defaults to three with a 1–8 setting.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/tasks-and-inbox
sources.finding: Durable to-dos are separate from chats and can be edited/delegated by humans. Agents create/list/update the same records using stable request IDs.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/agent-gateway
sources.finding: App-owned MCP tools create, inspect, wait and message tasks with scoped active-turn authority; 1–20 task batch creation is idempotent.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/external-mcp
sources.finding: Local paired MCP clients can create/read/wait for scoped tasks using revocable audience-bound credentials; remote server access disables this endpoint.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/headless-server
sources.finding: Node headless tarball serves web UI independently of Electron, with private state directory, token authentication and deliberate remote TLS policy.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/connectors
sources.finding: Remote MCP connectors are stable in 1.0.9+. Provider support and new-session requirements are explicit; credentials remain in local server secret storage.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/conversation-history
sources.finding: Server-projected transcripts restore rollback state; imported history is separately paged with retries.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/workspace-editor
sources.finding: Workspace files autosave with conflict handling; revision/turn diffs and checkpoint recovery support review.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/worktrees
sources.finding: Managed task worktrees separate directories/branches and protect active environments from routine cleanup.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/pull-requests
sources.finding: GitHub PR aggregation, repair context and checks are integrated; Git and GitHub remain authoritative.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/automations
sources.finding: Product-owned schedules retain run history and completion conditions; default failure threshold disables after three consecutive failures.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: workflows/handoffs
sources.finding: A provider handoff can retain task ID, worktree and transcript, while native provider state does not transfer.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: features/synara-beta
sources.finding: Stable/Beta use separate data homes and feeds. Beta sends crash/usage diagnostics; Stable never sends Beta diagnostics.

sources.title: Synara v1.1.0 documentation: troubleshooting/diagnostics
sources.finding: Local diagnostics support inspecting runtime failures and submitting redacted reports.

sources.finding: Calls Synara a free, open-source, local-first workspace under the MIT license. Synara does not sell a model plan or need a Synara cloud account; it uses provider accounts you already have.

sources.title: Synara docs: Beta and Remote diagnostics (v1.5.0)
sources.locator: docs/diagnostics.md lines 1-13 and 86-91 (Product analytics), release v1.5.0 commit df7d8fb
sources.finding: Stable never constructs the release-diagnostics sender. Desktop Settings, General, Privacy has a Share product analytics switch, off by default in Stable and Beta; Remote diagnostics follow a Share usage and diagnostics switch, and turning sharing off removes unsent diagnostics. Beta release diagnostics remain automatic.

sources.title: Synara REMOTE.md: remote access setup (v1.5.0)
sources.locator: REMOTE.md lines 1-3 and 28-46, release v1.5.0 commit df7d8fb
sources.finding: To use Synara from a phone, tablet or another laptop, run the built server with an auth token bound to a LAN or Tailnet address and open http://<machine-ip>:3773 in the phone's browser.
